home.title: Souls Challenge Generator
home.lead: Challenge runs for Dark Souls Remastered that hold together: a starting class, a set of rules and an objective that never contradict each other, rebuilt exactly from a single seed.
home.step1: Dark Souls Remastered for now. More Souls games will follow.
home.step2: Choose how hard it gets and which kinds of rules are allowed, or leave everything to luck.
home.step3: Every run has a seed. Send it to a friend and they get exactly the same challenge.
home.eyebrow: Made by a fan, for fans · Dark Souls Remastered
home.exampleBody: Every seed deals a card like this one. Open it to see every rule and copy the link.

about.title: About
about.intro: Souls Challenge Generator builds challenge runs for Souls games: a starting class, a handful of rules and an objective. Every run comes from a seed, so the same seed always rebuilds the same run, on any device.
about.coherence: Rules that contradict each other never appear together, and equipment picks respect the rest of the run. Under Soul Level 1, for example, the chosen weapon is always usable with the starting class's attributes.
about.data: Names, numbers and categories were gathered from community wikis and cross-checked between sources. No descriptions, lore, images or other official assets are used.
about.disclaimer: Souls Challenge Generator is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project, made by a fan for fans. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored, or approved by FromSoftware, Inc. or Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc. Dark Souls and all related names, characters, and game content are trademarks and/or copyrighted material of their respective owners. No official game assets are used in this project.
about.license: The source code is available under the MIT license, which covers only the original code and assets of this project.

hollow.name: Hollow
hollow.description: One or two light rules. A gentle first challenge.

undead.name: Undead
undead.description: Two or three rules, some of them demanding.

chosen.name: Chosen Undead
chosen.description: Three or four rules that change how you play.

lord-of-cinder.name: Lord of Cinder
lord-of-cinder.description: Four or five rules, the harshest ones included.

main-bosses.name: Required bosses
main-bosses.description: Defeat the {count} bosses needed to finish the game.

min-bosses.name: Fewest bosses
min-bosses.description: Reach the ending while defeating as few bosses as you can. Skips and glitches are fair game.

level.name: Level
level.description: Limits on leveling up and spending souls.

equipment.name: Equipment
equipment.description: What you may wear, wield and slot.

movement.name: Movement
movement.description: How you may move and dodge.

combat.name: Combat
combat.description: How you may defend and take hits.

absurd.name: Absurd
absurd.description: Ridiculous runs for veterans. Off by default.

sl1.name: Soul Level 1
sl1.description: Never level up. Your starting attributes are all you get.

no-armor.name: No armor
no-armor.description: Wear nothing in any armor slot for the whole run.

no-rolling.name: No rolling
no-rolling.description: Never roll. Walk, block or backstep out of danger instead.

no-estus.name: No Estus
no-estus.description: Never drink from the Estus Flask.

no-bonfires.name: No bonfire rest
no-bonfires.description: You may light bonfires, but never rest at one.

bow-only.name: Bows only
bow-only.description: Bows and greatbows are your only weapons.

weapon-category.name: One weapon type
weapon-category.description: Only use weapons of the type shown on this card.

specific-weapon.name: One weapon
specific-weapon.description: Only use the weapon shown on this card. Upgrading it is allowed.

cosplay.name: Cosplay
cosplay.description: Wear the full armor set shown on this card as soon as you find it.

naked-start.name: Naked start
naked-start.description: Start as the Deprived, with only a club and a plank shield.

one-ring.name: One ring slot
one-ring.description: Wear at most one ring at a time.

no-sprinting.name: No sprinting
no-sprinting.description: Never hold the run button to sprint.

no-jumping.name: No jumping
no-jumping.description: Never jump. Plunging attacks after walking off a ledge are fine.

no-blocking.name: No blocking
no-blocking.description: Never block, with a shield or a weapon.

no-parrying.name: No parrying
no-parrying.description: Never parry. Ripostes after a guard break are still allowed.

boss-no-hit.name: No-hit bosses
boss-no-hit.description: If a boss hits you, the attempt is lost: die or quit and fight it again.

no-estus-upgrades.name: No Estus reinforcement
no-estus-upgrades.description: Never use Firekeeper Souls to strengthen your Estus.

permadeath.name: Permadeath
permadeath.description: One death ends the run. Start a new character to try again.

boss-weapons-only.name: Boss weapons only
boss-weapons-only.description: Only use weapons made from boss souls. Until you have one, fight with your fists.

tail-weapons-only.name: Tail weapons only
tail-weapons-only.description: Only use weapons earned by cutting a tail. Until you have one, fight with your fists.

enemy-drops-only.name: Enemy drops only
enemy-drops-only.description: Only use weapons dropped by enemies. Until one drops, fight with your fists.

region-weapons.name: Local weapons
region-weapons.description: Only use weapons found, bought or dropped in the region shown on this card.

upgrade-cap.name: Upgrade limit
upgrade-cap.description: Never reinforce a weapon past the level shown on this card. Infusions that need a higher level are out of reach.

no-buying.name: No shopping
no-buying.description: Never buy anything from a merchant. Blacksmith services are still allowed.

level-cap.name: Level cap
level-cap.description: Never go past the soul level shown on this card.

single-stat.name: One attribute
single-stat.description: When you level up, only raise the attribute shown on this card.

no-spending-souls.name: Never spend souls
no-spending-souls.description: No leveling, buying, reinforcing or repairing. Souls only pile up.

spell-school-only.name: Spells only
spell-school-only.description: Deal damage only with spells of the school shown on this card. No weapon attacks and no spells from other schools.

weapon-roulette.name: Weapon roulette
weapon-roulette.description: Use the first weapon on the list, and switch to the next one after each boss you defeat. After the last, start over.

consumables-only.name: Consumables only
consumables-only.description: Deal damage only with thrown and used items: firebombs, knives, dung pies and the like.

firebombs-only.name: Firebombs only
firebombs-only.description: Firebombs and Black Firebombs are your only source of damage.

throwing-knives-only.name: Throwing knives only
throwing-knives-only.description: Throwing knives of any kind are your only source of damage.

poison-only.name: Poison only
poison-only.description: Only poison and toxic may hurt your enemies. Any direct damage you deal must be by accident.

thorns-only.name: Armor of Thorns
thorns-only.description: Your only damage comes from rolling into enemies while wearing the Armor of Thorns.

shield-only.name: Shield only
shield-only.description: Shields are your only weapons. Bash your way through.

one-shot.name: One shot
one-shot.description: Every kill in the scope shown on this card takes a single attack input, buffs and plunges included. If it survives, die or quit and try again.

errors.outdatedTitle: This seed is from an earlier version
errors.outdated: It was made with ruleset {seedVersion}, and this version uses ruleset {currentVersion}, so the same run can't be rebuilt. Generate a new one instead.
errors.newerTitle: This seed is from a newer version
errors.newer: It needs ruleset {seedVersion}, but this page only knows ruleset {currentVersion}. Reload the page to get the latest version.
errors.generation: Allow more rule types and try again.

notFound.title: This path leads nowhere
notFound.body: The page you were looking for doesn't exist, or it moved. Head back to the bonfire and pick another way.

buffs.name: Buffs
buffs.description: Spells and items that strengthen your weapon or yourself, such as resins.

summons.name: Summons
summons.description: Help from NPC phantoms or other players.

glitches.name: Glitches
glitches.description: Exploits, clips and skips. Off means a glitchless run.
